name: Santa in House
tagline: A Santa gift-drop clip generated in the home shown in your photograph.
description: For a Christmas surprise grounded in a familiar place, Santa in House uses a photograph of the buyer’s empty room, front door or house facade. The result is an eight-second landscape scene with sound, styled as a doorbell, yard or night-vision camera recording. It is generated family entertainment, not evidence of an actual visit. A still image costs 10 credits; Standard video uses 50 and HD uses 100. Credit packs begin at $1.99 and are purchased once, without a subscription. People, including children, must be absent from the source photograph.
